name: Multi-Space Transfer Function Blending (Hardware Limitation Approach)
definition: A method for blending transfer functions defined in different spaces (e.g., gradient magnitude) by limiting combinations to three unique dimensions that do not share a common space, due to hardware texture constraints.
summary: Multi-Space Transfer Function Blending combines transfer functions from different data spaces into a single 3D RGBA texture, constrained by hardware limits to three unique dimensions.
